overview: White plays 3.c3 to build a pawn centre with d4, as in the Giuoco Piano, after Bc4 Bc5. Black usually plays 3...Nf6 and White chooses between 4.d4 exd4 5.cxd4 Bb4+ (open play) or the quiet 4.d3. White wants the ideal centre and Black counters with ...d5. It is a respectable, flexible Italian-style position.

white_ideas.idea: Develop Nf3, O-O, Bb3 and play d4
Aim for a small edge in an open position

typical_structures.structure: Italian-style centre with c3/d4 against e5/d5
Open centre after d4 exd4 cxd4

character.notes: Balanced and flexible, between the Italian's quiet and open lines.

structure.notes: Centre in tension, White's d4 and Black's ...d5 undecided, flexible.

approach.notes: A sound line used from time to time.
